levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The refrigerator temperature check, the date check on real items, or the raw-versus-ready-to-eat observation is missing or clearly not based on an actual look.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three real checks (temperature awareness, at least five real dated items, and raw-versus-ready-to-eat placement) are completed and specific findings are reported.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner checks a second real storage location or item type beyond the minimum required.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Named risks or changes are generic (for example, 'be more careful') rather than tied to what was actually found.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two specific, real changes are named that are clearly tied to the learner's own findings.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains the specific mechanism by which the current arrangement could cause cross-contamination.

lookFors: The findings describe the learner's own real household storage, not a hypothetical or invented kitchen.
The reflection connects a real finding to a real proposed change rather than restating general food-safety advice.

A learner who completed the simulation/equal-credit alternative instead of the real-world version should be scored on this same rubric using the alternative submission as the evidence — using the sanctioned alternative is not itself a reason to score lower.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
